evidenceClass: parent-observed actual model run; structural summary, not replayable raw events

input.claim: Installed opencode api documents --data / -d for a request body; compare installed help only, do not edit or send a request.

capture.transport: authenticated live /api/event; connected before child dispatch
capture.binding: session.created exact parent/project/directory; ID independently matches native subagent launch
capture.upstreamScope: global event feed; nonmatching and ephemeral frames discarded

native.executedFlagLimit: Raw provider-executed flag is not interpreted as proof of local execution or absence. Shell exit/result records were checked separately.

adapter.semanticMapping: generic shell execution only; no call-specific CLI-help or assistant-report inference

measurements.basis: native execution timestamps and sum of four session.step.ended token/cost fields
measurements.nativeTotalReason: No total field; no total guessed from potentially overlapping native classes.

parentReviewBindings.reviewer: parent agent; not independent human review

answer.assessment: Final assistant answer reports help agreement, explicitly not runtime parsing/body serialization/request/deployment success.

parentReviewBindings.negativeCoverage: All six projected native tool inputs/metadata inspected: selected scratch read, startup skill/read-only memory operations, binary/version observation and help. No write, publication, permission/config or lifecycle command in this recorded sequence.
parentReviewBindings.runtimeLimit: CLI internals and no-service-contact behavior were not instrumented; no claim of full runtime parsing or effective provider identity.

limitations: Raw adapter output does not satisfy semantic CLI-help/report targets; reviewed trace is a separate parent annotation.
Static regression tests check this retained evidence and grading distinction; they do not rerun the model or authenticate the summary.
Original raw events were intentionally not persisted; the digest does not make this structural summary independently replayable.
Candidate remains unreviewed human gold. This is one help-only task, not broad model compliance, a matched benchmark or hosted enforcement.
